reason: I've drunk the same energy drink for years and I know exactly how it hits before training, so I'm not switching to something I can't grab at the shop. The clean label is nice, but I'm not ordering cans online and I don't know which cafés stock it.
objection: Where do I actually buy it? If it's not in the shop or petrol station I pass every day, it won't replace my usual can, and 80 mg might feel weaker than what I'm used to.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing it in the fridge at my gym or the supermarket I already shop at, so I could try one can before a workout without any effort.
